description: v0 link rules from GitHub-collected fields to existing TAP grid entities. Engine reads this manifest; rules are evaluated during the enrichment phase. Adds REFERENCES_RESOURCE edges only — no nodes created or modified.

rules.name: workflow_yaml_domain_name_to_route53_zone
rules.description: Domain names mentioned in workflow YAML (env vars, parameters) that match a Route 53 hosted zone's name.

rules.name: workflow_yaml_aws_region_to_region
rules.description: AWS region codes (us-east-1, etc.) mentioned in workflow YAML that match an aws_region node.

rules.name: workflow_yaml_cloudfront_distribution_id
rules.description: CloudFront distribution IDs visible in workflow YAML that match an aws_cloudfront_distribution node.

rules.name: repo_federates_with_github_oidc_provider
rules.description: Structural link: every collected GitHub repository points at the AWS IAM OIDC provider whose URL is the canonical github.com Actions issuer. Refuses to link if (a) AWS has multiple OIDC providers with that exact URL (IAM enforces uniqueness so this is defensive), or (b) AWS has an OIDC provider whose URL matches the near-match pattern but isn't an exact match for the canonical value (GHES tenants, alternate audiences, typos — warns rather than guesses). Pattern is a Postgres POSIX regex evaluated via Gryphon's `=~` operator; `(?i)` prefix opts into case-insensitive matching.
